summary.purpose: Help teams develop software in Bosch Corporate Design.
summary.core_requirement: Teams need a basic understanding of Core and the general design principles of the Digital Design System to fully implement the designs.

responsive_layout_grid.definition: Guide for placing components and elements within software; adapts to screen sizes and alignments to keep layouts consistent.
structure_rules: Baseline grid: align all components to a square 0.5 rem / 8 px baseline grid across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Column grid: keep spacing to screen margins and between columns/gutters at least 1 rem / 16 px; other possible spacings are 1.5 rem or 2 rem.
Column amount: use the divisible 12-column grid for 12, 6, 4, 3, 2, or 1 evenly spaced columns; another column count may be used as a design aid.

breakpoints.margin_gutters: 2 rem / 2 rem; left 80 px and right 32 px when side navigation is closed
2 rem / 2 rem; left 80 px and right 32 px when side navigation is closed

notes: Margins and gutters are flexible and can equal 1, 1.5, or 2 rem.
The side navigation is offset to the baseline grid; left margin equals 80 px when closed and 288 px when opened.
Font sizes and line spacing are generally defined in rem and predefined in Core.

spacings.definition: Bosch Digital Design System provides predefined spacing within components and between components.

page_structure.definition: Pages can be structured with dividers or differing background colors, depending on content amount and structure.
simple_structure_primary_background: Place content on a Primary Background.
Use Primary Background generally for simple content.
Use Dividers on long pages as structural elements, but do not combine Dividers with tables on the same page.
strong_structure_surfaces: Use the Card component for strong structuring with differing surface colors.
Content can be placed on the Card and on the grey Secondary Background; allocation must be reasonable and logical.
Use for long pages with complex content, for example when multiple tables or forms are consecutive.

message_types.definition: Feedback can be provided through messages with three priorities.

rules: Shown temporarily and fades away independently without user interaction.
Does not contain a Close Button.
Can inform users of a successful interaction, such as data being saved.
Informs users of successful actions taken.
Can display further information via Text Links.
Can inform users of correct or incorrect input.
Can trigger an interaction process via confirmation, such as delete.

references.jira_process: Feature requests and bug reports relating to the Digital Design System or Frontend Kit should be submitted directly to the digital expert team via Jira.
references.design_review_note: The support team can also check design drafts.

ai.recommended_use: Use this file as structured research for AI agents that need to generate or evaluate Bosch-aligned software UI, design QA, documentation, and prompts.
ai.traceability: Structured guidance is derived from accessible text, page section navigation, and asset metadata in the supplied HTML file.
limitations: Visual details embedded inside images were not OCR-extracted.
Some Frontify dynamic content may not be fully represented in the static saved HTML.
Columns values in the breakpoint visual/table were not available as explicit accessible text in the parsed HTML.
